subject: Cleanup redundant incrRefCount and fix new_argv alloc size around HDEL (#4059)
reason: Pure cleanup with no behaviour change. incrRefCount(shared.hdel) was a no-op: shared.hdel is created with OBJ_SHARED_REFCOUNT (server.c:2219) and both incrRefCount and decrRefCount return early for shared objects (object.c:116,619,644), so adding or removing the call changes nothing on either build. The new_argv allocation in hexpireGenericCommand shrinks from num_fields+3 to num_fields+2, which is exactly sufficient: the vector holds shared.hdel, the key, and at most one entry per field, and num_fields is validated to equal the real field count (t_hash.c:1912), so no write can exceed num_fiel
